title: ZTIE combined-event (telemetry aggregation / normalization) contract (v1)
description: The shared, NORMALIZED combined-event record produced by the Story 3.1 Hub-side aggregation/normalization (RD-033) for one intake artifact, and the FIRST Phase-3 (Correlation & Synthesis) artifact. It aggregates the three per-lane derived outputs ALREADY on the Hub tracking record — the static-scan summary (2.1/2.2), the dynamic-run outcome (2.3) and the sanitized behavioral telemetry (2.5) — into ONE consistent shape the Phase-3 Nova Pro correlation engine (3.2) reasons over, rather than three differently-shaped records. It is NOT a Forensic -> Hub crossing (all inputs are already Hub-side); it is a Hub-INTERNAL derived field written back onto the same tracking item by the 3.1 normalizer Lambda, so it carries NO gate discriminator. It REFERENCES — never duplicates — the per-lane detail: the full findings document, command log and raw trace all stay in Forensic (RD-009); only bounded roll-ups + pointers + the ALREADY-sanitized 2.5 events (re-shaped, not re-sanitized) appear here. It records WHICH inputs are present so a lane that has not landed yet (SQS ordering) or errored / produced no trace is captured honestly, never fabricated. All behavioral timings are RELATIVE monotonic offsets (ms) carried through from 2.5, never a wall clock (only 'combined_at' is wall-clock, for audit correlation). It is NOT a verdict: there is NO verdict/safe/approved/forward/pass_fail/malicious/clean field anywhere; 'complete' is an aggregation-completeness fact and the verdict is Hub-side/human-gated (Phase 4). Allow-list: additionalProperties false at every level; every field typed and enum/length/range-bounded; every array maxItems-capped. Integrity-keyed by intake_id + sha256. DERIVED-ONLY. OWN version pin (COMBINED_EVENT_CONTRACT_VERSION).

contract_version.description: Combined-event-contract schema version. Pinned SEPARATELY on the 3.1 normalizer (COMBINED_EVENT_CONTRACT_VERSION) so this record versions independently of the shared CONTRACT_VERSION and every crossing kind's pin.

intake_id.description: The intake UUIDv4 this combined event is for. The normalizer writes it back onto the tracking record keyed by this.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the raw artifact body all lanes inspected. Integrity key, bound to intake_id; the normalizer only combines inputs whose sha256 matches the tracked record.

combined_at.description: RFC3339/ISO-8601 UTC timestamp (Z-suffixed) the normalizer produced this combined event in the Hub. This is the ONLY wall-clock field — all behavioral timings are relative offsets carried through from 2.5 (signals.behavioral_events[].offset_ms).

combined_event.description: The NORMALIZED combined event for one intake: the per-input source roll-ups (static / dynamic / sanitized, by reference), the normalized cross-lane signals (what 3.2 correlates), and the aggregation-completeness facts (which inputs are present, whether the aggregation is complete). It REFERENCES — never duplicates — the per-lane evidence (RD-009). EVIDENCE only; no verdict anywhere. 'complete' says whether all three inputs have landed, NOT whether the artifact is safe.

inputs_present.description: The set of inputs actually present on the tracking record and normalized into this combined event (subset of static / dynamic / sanitized). An input that has not landed yet is simply not listed here (and its source records presence 'absent') — a recorded gap, never a silent drop or a fabrication.

complete.description: True iff all three inputs (static, dynamic, sanitized) are present and normalized. An AGGREGATION-completeness fact for Phase-3 correlation — NOT a safety verdict; a complete combined event can still describe a high-severity finding or an execution error.

sources.description: The three per-input source roll-ups, by reference. Each records whether its input is present and, when present, a bounded roll-up + Forensic pointer. Present-but-absent inputs are RECORDED, never fabricated.

static.description: The normalized STATIC input for this intake, by reference to the crossed static-scan summary (2.1/2.2) already on the tracking record. Records whether the input is present and, when present, the worst severity it rolled up + a POINTER to the full findings document in Forensic (RD-009). It does NOT re-embed the per-finding detail. EVIDENCE, never a verdict.

presence.description: Whether the static-scan summary is present on the tracking record yet. 'absent' is RECORDED honestly (it may land later); never a verdict.

highest_severity.description: The worst normalized severity carried through from the static-scan summary ('none' when zero findings). Present when the input is present. Descriptive EVIDENCE, NOT a decision.

total_findings.description: Total finding count carried through from the static-scan summary. Bounded; the full findings document stays in Forensic (RD-009).

summary_contract_version.description: Version of the static-scan-summary contract this roll-up was normalized from, for traceability.

findings_s3_bucket.description: Forensic S3 bucket holding the full findings document (RD-009 — referenced, not duplicated).

findings_s3_key.description: Forensic S3 key of the full findings document (findings/<intake_id>/static-findings.json).

dynamic.description: The normalized DYNAMIC input for this intake, by reference to the crossed dynamic-run outcome (2.3) already on the tracking record. Records whether the input is present and, when present, the controlled-run outcome + a POINTER to the full command log in Forensic (RD-009). It does NOT re-embed the run detail. EVIDENCE, never a verdict.

presence.description: Whether the dynamic-run outcome is present on the tracking record yet. 'absent' is RECORDED honestly; never a verdict.

outcome.description: The controlled-run outcome carried through from the dynamic-run envelope. Present when the input is present. Describes how the ORCHESTRATION ended — NOT whether the artifact is safe.

run_contract_version.description: Version of the dynamic-run contract this roll-up was normalized from, for traceability.

run_log_s3_bucket.description: Forensic S3 bucket holding the full command output log (RD-009 — referenced, not duplicated).

run_log_s3_key.description: Forensic S3 key of the full command output log (runs/<intake_id>/detonation-output.json).

sanitized.description: The normalized SANITIZED-TELEMETRY input for this intake, by reference to the crossed sanitized view (2.5) already on the tracking record. Records whether the input is present, the sanitization pipeline health + token accounting, and a POINTER to the full raw trace in Forensic (RD-009). The actual normalized events live under signals.behavioral_events (carried through from the ALREADY-sanitized 2.5 events; 3.1 re-shapes, it does NOT re-sanitize). EVIDENCE, never a verdict.

presence.description: Whether the sanitized telemetry is present on the tracking record yet. 'absent' is RECORDED honestly; never a verdict.

capture_status.description: Sanitization/capture health carried through from the sanitized view's pipeline.status (sanitized / no_trace / sanitize_error). EVIDENCE of health — a missing trace is RECORDED, never a verdict.

truncated.description: True iff the 2.5 <=25K-token truncation dropped one or more kept events to fit the budget. A completeness fact carried through, not a verdict.

estimated_tokens.description: The deterministic estimated token count of the sanitized view, carried through from 2.5 (chars/4 heuristic, never a live tokenizer).

sanitized_contract_version.description: Version of the sanitized-telemetry contract this roll-up was normalized from, for traceability.

trace_s3_bucket.description: Forensic S3 bucket holding the full raw behavioral trace (RD-009 — referenced, not duplicated).

trace_s3_key.description: Forensic S3 key of the full raw behavioral trace (traces/<intake_id>/behavior-trace.txt).

signals.description: The NORMALIZED cross-lane signal set the Phase-3 Nova Pro correlation engine (3.2) reasons over: the static misconfiguration roll-up aligned with the dynamic behavioral indicators on ONE common shape. Every field is carried through by reference from an input already on the tracking record; a signal whose input is absent is simply omitted (never fabricated). EVIDENCE only — NO verdict anywhere.

static_highest_severity.description: The worst static severity (from the static input), surfaced at the signals level for correlation. Present iff the static input is present. Descriptive EVIDENCE, not a decision.

dynamic_outcome.description: The controlled-run outcome (from the dynamic input), surfaced at the signals level for correlation. Present iff the dynamic input is present. Describes the orchestration, not the artifact's safety.

behavioral_event_count.description: Number of normalized behavioral events carried through into behavioral_events (<= the 2.5 emitted_events, <= MAX_EVENTS). A bounded count; the full trace stays in Forensic (RD-009).

behavioral_events.description: The bounded, token-budgeted, already-sanitized behavioral event sequence (in trace order), carried through from the 2.5 sanitized view and re-shaped into the combined schema. Empty when the sanitized input is absent or recorded no trace. The full trace stays in Forensic (RD-009). Inert EVIDENCE; never executed.

items.description: One normalized behavioral event carried through from the ALREADY-sanitized 2.5 events (entropy-scrubbed, noise-suppressed, token-budgeted). 3.1 re-shapes it into the combined schema; it does NOT re-capture or re-sanitize. Inert EVIDENCE for Phase-3 correlation; never executed.

offset_ms.description: RELATIVE monotonic offset (ms) from detonation start, carried through from the 2.5 event. A relative clock only — never a wall clock (RD-031).

category.description: Behavioral category (file / network / process / signal / other), carried through from the 2.5 event.

syscall.description: Syscall name for this event, carried through from the 2.5 event (structure kept; only high-entropy VALUES were redacted upstream).

summary.description: The already-SANITIZED one-line summary carried through from the 2.5 event (high-entropy values already replaced by a bounded '[REDACTED:...]' marker upstream). Inert EVIDENCE, never executed.

redacted.description: True iff the upstream 2.5 entropy scrub redacted one or more high-entropy values in this event. A sanitization-accounting fact carried through, not a verdict.

normalize_note.description: Optional short, bounded, non-executable note about the normalization (e.g. 'sanitized input not yet present; re-derives on next update'). Never raw content, never a verdict.
